ev.q: Comparison of 2015–2020 suicides among all AI/AN and non-AI/AN decedents in 49 states
During 2015–2020, a total of 3,397 suicides among AI/AN persons and 179,850 suicides among non-AI/AN persons were recorded
Nearly 45% of AI/AN suicide decedents (compared with 18.7% of non-AI/AN suicide decedents) lived in nonmetropolitan areas.
AI/AN suicide decedents had higher odds of dying by hanging, strangulation, or suffocation (aOR = 1.8)
AI/AN suicide decedents had higher adjusted odds of a range of relationship and alcohol or other substance use problems
Each aOR used non-AI/AN as the referent group and controlled for age group and sex.
NVDRS is a state-based surveillance system that collects information from death certificates
This analysis was reviewed by CDC and was conducted consistent with applicable federal law and CDC policy.

methods_quotes.q: logistic regression analyses, controlling for age and sex to estimate aORs with 95% CIs
All comparisons between AI/AN and non-AI/AN persons were examined using Pearson’s chi-square tests
Each aOR used non-AI/AN as the referent group and controlled for age group and sex.
